wallpaper_cage.description: The symmetry seam. Rotation is a continuous dial - any real angle turns the circle (SO(2), a smooth infinity of symmetries). But a periodic tiling admits only 1, 2, 3, 4, 6-fold rotation - the crystallographic restriction. Five-fold never closes. Amber: the continuous dial. Blue: the five allowed orders. Red: the forbidden ones. From this cage falls a finite catalogue - exactly 17 wallpaper groups, the complete list of ways a pattern can repeat. The continuum walks in, a countable law walks out.
wallpaper_cage.name: Wallpaper Cage
wallpaper_cage.qfep_connection: A station in the bias landscape (doc/SEAM_PER_SEQUENCE.md); the digital-bias seam for symmetry. Bias is conserved; show the seam.
